title.value: AICOM-MP: AN AI- BASED MONKEYPOX DETECTOR FOR RESOURCE-CONSTRAINED ENVIRONMENTS
title.justification: The paper's title clearly states the purpose of the research, which is to develop an AI-based detector for monkeypox specifically designed for resource-constrained environments.
title.quote: AICOM-MP: AN AI- BASED MONKEYPOX DETECTOR FOR RESOURCE-CONSTRAINED ENVIRONMENTS

extractions.description: AICOM-MP presents an AI-based solution for detecting monkeypox, aimed at enhancing healthcare accessibility in least developed countries through Autonomous Mobile Clinics. The paper discusses the creation and open-sourcing of AICOM-MP technology for universal access, especially in resource-limited settings.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on deploying health AI technologies to improve healthcare accessibility in least developed countries, aligning with Sustainable Development Goal 3 on health.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Particularly, AMCs answer to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 3 (SDG3) on health, which represents a universal recognition that health is fundamental to human capital and social and economic development.

primary_category.justification: The paper's main focus is on improving healthcare delivery in resource-constrained environments, specifically in least developed countries, by utilizing AI-based technologies.
primary_category.quote: ...open sourcing, and standardizing health AI technologies to enable healthcare access in least developed countries (LDCs).

secondary_categories.justification: While the primary focus is on healthcare, the autonomous mobile clinics are seen as adapting healthcare delivery methods to serve vulnerable populations, which is a form of adaptation in the face of potential socioeconomic disruptions.
secondary_categories.quote: ...autonomous mobile clinics are self-driving vehicles equipped with medical diagnostic equipment, telemedicine capability and an artificial intelligence (AI) software...bringing health-care services to hard-to-reach populations.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper describes the development and open-sourcing of an AI-based health application to improve healthcare access in least developed countries, which involves significant policy and knowledge sharing components.
primary_sub_category.quote: We have hosted AICOM-MP as a web service to allow universal access to monkeypox screening technology. We have also open sourced both the source code and the dataset of AICOM-MP.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: Providing access to health care through mobile clinics and AI-based screening targets relief in urgent and underserved situations, akin to relief efforts.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: ...monkeypox detector specially aiming for handling images taken from resource-constrained devices...

applications.value: AI-based monkeypox detection in resource-constrained environments
applications.justification: This application is directly aimed at improving health diagnostics in areas with limited resources, such as least developed countries.
applications.quote: ...introduce AICOM-MP, an AI-based monkeypox detector specially aiming for handling images taken from resourceconstrained devices.

applications.value: Universal access to monkeypox screening technology
applications.justification: The technology is designed for broad accessibility to mitigate health challenges globally.
applications.quote: ...AICOM-MP exists in the form of a web service, such that it can be accessed through equipment...especially low-resolution images taken on resource-constrained devices.

applications.value: Methodology for developing health AI technologies
applications.justification: The paper outlines a general methodology for AI deployment in health settings, extending beyond the specific case of monkeypox.
applications.quote: With the methodology introduced in this article, we have generalized a methodology for developing health AI engines...

new_primary_category.justification: The existing Sustainable Development categories sufficiently cover the paper's themes and objectives.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The existing sub-categories adequately classify the specific focus areas of the paper.
